description: Calculate the PBE band gap of bulk silicon in the cubic diamond structure.
user_prompt: Calculate the band gap of bulk silicon Si (cubic, Fd-3m) and report its value in eV.

method.modeling: Use bulk silicon in the cubic diamond Fd-3m structure and report the indirect fundamental gap from the valence-band maximum at Gamma to the conduction-band minimum near X.
method.rationale: The scored value is the 0.61 eV PBE band gap reported by Ma et al. for bulk silicon in VASP; the same work reports an HSE gap of 1.14 eV and notes consistency with the experimental room-temperature gap near 1.13 eV. This case intentionally scores the semilocal PBE underestimate. The absolute tolerance covers k-point resolution of the off-symmetry conduction-band minimum, relaxed-lattice sensitivity, and ordinary cutoff convergence.
